rationale: Original is track 3 of Butterfly (Sept 1997); 'Hits 98' does not exist in the UK Hits series (1997's was 'Big Hits', 1998's were 'New/Big Hits 98') and the single was not released until April 1998, so the filed comp is bogus. | sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_All, https://www.discogs.com/release/1828344-Mariah-Carey-Butterfly
